title: angular-django2 site schematic
description: Assemble a Material site from one bounded site assembly definition. Without --source, pass --defaults to generate the documented Home-only site.

source.description: Workspace-relative JSON site assembly definition. It is the only source used to discover site pages, navigation, forms, and optional OpenAPI setup.

defaults.description: Generate only the documented Home-only default definition when --source is omitted.

project.description: Target Angular application project. Required when the workspace has more than one application.

operation.description: create records a new site, modify updates a recorded site, and delete removes only the recorded site shell and ownership manifest.

confirmDelete.description: Required with --operation=delete. Site never deletes generated pages, forms, routes, or user-owned source files.

authGuard.description: Existing reusable guard identifier for protected pages. The guard must already be imported and applied in app.routes.ts.

csrfCookieName.description: Django CSRF cookie name configured through withXsrfConfiguration.

csrfHeaderName.description: Django CSRF request header configured through withXsrfConfiguration.
